name: ombre-du-dojo
description: Combat vue de côté façon shinobi : plateformes, katana + coup de pied, décors japonais, boutique.

scripts.sync:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html style.css game.js boot.js manifest.webmanifest telecharger.html telecharger.css telecharger-boot.js icon.svg version.json sw.js www/ && cp -a assets www/
scripts.sync:native: npm run sync:www && rm -rf ../ombre-du-dojo-android/app/src/main/assets/public && mkdir -p ../ombre-du-dojo-android/app/src/main/assets/public && cp -a www/. ../ombre-du-dojo-android/app/src/main/assets/public/ && cp capacitor.config.json ../ombre-du-dojo-android/app/src/main/assets/capacitor.config.json
scripts.apk: npm run sync:native && cd ../ombre-du-dojo-android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../dist && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../dist/ombre-du-dojo.apk
